text: The AI CSS generator understands everyday requests like 'make the title bigger' and uses the builder's design-system colours rather than fixed values. Plain-language prompts produce on-brand CSS for the right element; structural requests get a clear 'styling only' reply.

summary: Story 1: "Describe CSS Changes" UI Entry Point
text: A 'Describe CSS Changes' input in a Website Builder block's Dev settings, where power users describe styling in plain language for AI to apply. Behind a feature flag, power users request AI-generated CSS from a block, with a loading state and a clear error if it fails.

The Website Builder captures a block's HTML snapshot, style IDs and design tokens (colours, fonts, buttons) to send with AI CSS requests. AI styling requests carry the block's structure and brand tokens, truncated safely and with no personal data.

summary: Story 3: Secure Backend Proxy for AI Requests
text: A secure backend proxy forwards AI CSS requests to the AI provider so the API key never reaches the browser. AI CSS requests are validated, routed server-side and return structured errors on timeouts or bad input.

AI-generated CSS is shown for review first and, once confirmed, applied only to the block being edited, not to global styles. Power users confirm or cancel AI CSS per block; oversized results are rejected.

Created a copy of the delegates page widget showing 12 random attendee cards, cached server-side for 10 minutes, without interaction buttons. The attendee widget shows a rotating set of 12 cards with pagination, counts and Meet/Message/Favourite hidden; clicking a card opens the profile in the app page.

summary: Changing Website Language Based on Browser's Language
text: Set the front-end language selector to default to the visitor's browser language when that language is available on the site. Pages open in the browser's language when the site supports it, and users can still switch language manually.

summary: Add ability to edit old CSS
text: Added a switch in the custom CSS window to edit the old site builder's global CSS. Admins can edit both old and new global CSS.

summary: Add warning text to admin portal
text: Added SSL certificate warning text with a help link to the external domain setup in General Info. Organisers are told they can upload their own certificate or wait up to 2 hours for an auto-generated one, during which the URL will not work.

summary: Add external controls for FormBuilder tabs

text: Built the 'Custom form 1 (simple)' Website Builder block, which embeds a form from Marketing > Forms with general, colour and typography settings. Organisers place a chosen marketing form on the site and style it, or are prompted to create one; the block is hidden on the front if no form is added.

Built the Website Builder Custom Form blocks with image and with video, embedding a Marketing > Forms form with general, colour and typography settings. Organisers place a chosen form beside an image or video, styled to the site, or are prompted to create a form first.

Added a Custom Form pop-up block to the website builder with one-to-three-column layouts and one or two buttons, using Marketing forms. Organisers add a marketing form as a pop-up on site pages, over a darkened background, scrolling with pinned buttons up to 80% of screen height.

Added a Custom Form Sidebar block to the site builder: left or right full-height sidebar forms in 1–3 columns, with colours and display triggers. Site builders can show a created marketing form in a sidebar, triggered by exit intent, delay, scroll, page count, clicks or inactivity, per device.

summary: Introduce Custom Pop up check box on New web builder just like the legacy
text: Added a Pop-Up tab to the new Website Builder's Custom HTML block, with header, colour settings, display triggers and desktop/mobile toggles. Organisers show custom HTML as a pop-up triggered by delay, scroll, clicks or inactivity, with auto-close and per-device control.

summary: Website buider. Custom grids main functional
text: A Custom Grid in the Website Builder: 1–6 cells, grids inside grids, drag-and-drop elements between cells, resizable cells and minimum widths. Organisers compose multi-column layouts that fit, then wrap, on mobile.

summary: Custom grids improvements. Improve base structure and elements placement
text: The builder's Elements section is renamed Custom Grid and Elements (grid, text, button, image, video); banners and text blocks move to Static Blocks. Layout elements are easier to find and the builder's panels match how pages are put together.

summary: Custom grids improvements. Change settings placement
text: Custom Grid settings in the Website Builder are laid out horizontally, the same way as the Carousel block's settings. Grid settings are consistent with other builder blocks and quicker to scan.

summary: Custom grids. Improve number of columns display
text: The grid's column count uses segmented buttons instead of radio buttons, with a warning that changing it resets the layout. Organisers pick column counts more easily and are warned before they lose content.

summary: Add ability to run js scripts in the custom HTML block
[site builder] add the ability to show in full-screen custom HTML
[portalUI] Add CSS class or data attribute for customer
text: Added CSS classes or data attributes for the user's role, category and login state on the frontend. Custom CSS can target roles, categories and logged-in users.

summary: [iframe height] Add ability to get height in the widgets mode for portal UI
text: Let embedded frontend widgets report their content height so iframes can size to fit. Widget iframes can match their content height.

summary: Keep iframe id in session storage to observe height
New dates format for the events on the front
text: Changed event date ranges on the front-end Events page to compact formats covering one month, two months or two years. Events show dates like '10-15 Jan 2023', '28 Jan - 03 Feb 2023' or '28 Dec 2022 - 10 Jan 2023', matching admin settings.

Added a Feedback Form pop-up block under Dynamic content in the new Website builder, with emoji or star rating, up to six categories and a comment box. Site builders can add a customisable feedback pop-up (texts, colours, categories, position) that submits only after a rating is chosen.

summary: Reset button should be shown only if we have some filters applied
Show rest of google api key errors
text: Showed all Google API key errors in the form builder font settings. Admins see why Google fonts fail.

summary: Allignment of the columns in footer
epic: Changes to the footer based on CSS tasks
text: Added footer column alignment and column width settings to the website builder, with responsive layouts. Organisers align and size footer columns themselves.

summary: Add the ability to delete a column
epic: Changes to the footer based on CSS tasks
text: Added Delete column to footer link settings, with confirmation and reflowing the remaining columns. Admins can remove whole footer columns.

epic: Changes to the footer based on CSS tasks
text: Replaced the footer's Logo position with a Text position setting shown only when text is on, keeping existing layouts. Footer logo and text placement is clearer.

summary: Width in footer for logo + text
epic: Changes to the footer based on CSS tasks
text: Added a width setting for the footer's logo and text block in the website builder, between 216 and 500 px. Organisers can size the footer logo and text.

summary: Superadmin can toggle ExpoPlatform branding in Website Footer
text: Adds a Superadmin-only toggle in the Website Builder to show or hide the 'Powered by ExpoPlatform' footer branding per event across the event lifecycle. A Superadmin-only Website Builder setting that toggles the 'Powered by ExpoPlatform' footer logo and text per event, hidden from non-Superadmins.
Made the form tracking codes fire only on successful, validated form submission. GA4 form events are recorded only when a form passes validation and submits successfully.

Unified the website header across the new and old frontends: logos, colours, hovers, navigation, language switch, hideable dates, top-bar navigation and responsiveness. Headers look the same on both frontends with more layout options.

summary: Pass anchor id, custom css to header and footer from sitebuilder
Enhanced Control for Header and Footer Logos
text: Added header and footer logo controls to the website builder: clickable on/off, custom URL, same or new window, and title/subtitle colours. Admins make the logo static or link it anywhere, defaulting to the homepage in the same window.

Added an optional alt text field, with an SEO tips tooltip and an empty-field warning, to every image in the website builder, including header and footer. Organisers describe each image, including slides, so search engines index them and screen readers can read them.

summary: Ability to edit the tracking links
text: Organizers can now edit the name and destination URL of existing Marketing Tracking Links in place, without recreating and re-distributing them. An Edit action on each Tracking Link lets organizers update the name and landing page URL with validation, while the external tracked/short URL stays unchanged so existing campaign references keep working.
Made marketing custom forms and exhibitor event additional questions multilingual. Custom forms work in every event language.

Added website builder multilanguage sync (blocks shared across languages with independent text), optional desync, favourite blocks and an extra blocks section. Organisers keep language versions structurally in sync by default, can desync and later restore or reset them, and reuse favourited blocks across pages.

summary: Main menu of the Website builder
text: Built the Website builder main menu: add block, page switcher, device previews, language switcher, gallery, history, global settings, save and publish. The Website builder has a main menu under the header giving access to blocks, pages, previews, global styles, version history and publishing.

Built the Website Builder Global Settings screen with text styles, colours, buttons, favicon and SEO settings, including custom font upload. Organisers set site-wide fonts (including CDN or uploaded TTF/OTF/WOFF fonts) and theme, text, status and other colours with live previews, then save or close.

summary: Two Website builders on the Platform
text: Added a 'Use New Website builder' toggle in general settings so the new website builder runs alongside the old one. Organisers switch each event between the old and new website builders; the old builder stays the default.

Built the Website Builder Gallery: upload images, videos and files, create nested folders, sort, switch gallery/list layouts, paginate, and manage files. Organisers store and organise site media, with video conversion, file details, and rename, preview, move, copy, copy URL, download and delete actions.

summary: Setting to enable / disable the new Website builder
text: Added a 'New Website builder (Beta)' Module Management item (on by default) and a 'Use New Website builder' event setting (off by default). Organisers switch each event between the old and new website builders.

summary: Reduce the size of the shadow
text: Reduced the default shadow of testimonial blocks from 4px to 2px. Testimonial blocks have a lighter shadow.

summary: Make the News and sponsor cards’ corners rounded in the new website builder.
text: Rounded the corners of news and sponsor cards in the new website builder. News and sponsor cards match the design.

summary: Phase 3 New Builder - Ability to add more than 8 FAQs in the New web builder
text: Raised the new website builder's FAQ block limit above the fixed maximum of 8 (up to 30 per the tech brief; 50 is also noted). Organisers add more FAQs one by one in the editor, and the front end shows all that were added.

summary: Re-arrangement of Cards within Selected Blocks in Website Builder
text: Added drag-and-drop re-ordering of cards in the website builder's Cards Row (2, 3, 4 cards) and Cards with Counters blocks. Admins can drag cards into a new order within these blocks, as already possible for carousel cards.
Fixed invalid alt attributes and missing video attributes in the text, video and button block. The block produces valid HTML.

Added an aspect ratio selector for images in website builder content blocks. Images are cropped to the chosen aspect ratio, keeping them consistent across devices, since fixed pixel sizes cannot apply to responsive images.

summary: [New Website Builder] Change buttons aligning logic in Сards Carousel block
text: Aligned buttons per card in the website builder's cards carousel, matching the builder preview. Carousel buttons line up across cards.

summary: Hide color settings from legacy admin panel when new site builder enabled
New web builder - Ability to add links in images for 2, 3, 4 card rows & carousel
text: Added image link settings to the new web builder's 2, 3 and 4 Cards Row and Cards Carousel blocks. Images in these card blocks can link to a URL, in both new and existing blocks.

summary: Remove /page part from urls of custom pages in new website builder
text: Removed /page from custom page URLs in the new website builder and blocked slugs that clash with platform pages. Custom pages have clean URLs.

summary: [admin-ui] site builder add ability to change slub and input all data before make validation
text: Let admins type a full site builder slug before validation runs. Slugs can be typed naturally.

summary: Webbuilder. Update mechanism for existing blocks
text: Added an update mechanism to the new website builder that flags outdated blocks and lets users update one block or all on a page. Outdated blocks show an indicator; single updates list the changes before confirming, bulk updates apply page-wide, disabled while someone edits.

summary: [site build] Change mobile adaptive for FourCardView in system elements
text: Kept the four-card view on one line until the last breakpoint on mobile. The four-card block adapts better.

summary: Webbuilder stage3. Title and Subtitle block
text: Added a Title & Subtitle block to the new Website Builder's Elements, with and without background image, in six layout variants. Organisers add title and subtitle sections with toggleable title, subtitle and divider, background colour or image, text width and padding.

summary: New Website Builder: Adding Banners as OLD website
text: Added a Banner block to the new website builder with multiple image banners, hyperlinks, three sizes and timed automatic rotation. Admins add several linked banners to custom pages that rotate at a set interval without a page refresh.

summary: To keep “news items per page” and “page number” fixed after approving a news item in the back-end
text: Kept pagination, page size and search in the admin news list after approving, rejecting or deleting news. Admins stay on the same news page and search after moderating.

summary: Controls for TextEditor inherit theme from Builder
text: Styled text editor controls to the design instead of inheriting the builder theme. Editor controls match the design.

summary: Add the ability to open platform links and external links by clicking on the icon and fix typing
text: Let icons open platform and external links and renamed Robot.txt to robots.txt. Icon links work and robots.txt is correctly named.

Change div to section in root elements.

summary: [next14] render custom text and HTML on the server side
Change logic of the sitemap generation

summary: Disable autosave in the site builder
text: Disabled autosave in the site builder by default, with an option to turn it on. Site builder changes save only when chosen, unless autosave is enabled.

summary: [site builder] create a block with social links which should be attached to right/left border
text: Created a site builder block of social media icons fixed to the left or right edge. Websites can show floating social links.

summary: Add addition settings to all video blocks, autoplay true/false
text: Added an autoplay on/off setting to all video blocks. Organisers choose whether videos autoplay.

summary: Add border and shadow options for individual card views
text: Closed a styling-consistency gap in Website Builder so every static card view can carry borders and shadows, giving organizers a uniform, professional event-site look without design hacks. Border and shadow options were added to the card views that previously lacked them, while views that already supported the styling were left unchanged.

summary: Website Builder: Organizer can hide the button on individual Cards
text: Website Builder now lets organizers hide the call-to-action button on individual cards via a per-card toggle, removing the previous reliance on custom CSS. A per-card toggle was added to the Website Builder card component so organizers can show or hide the button on each card independently.

Defined the Website builder static content blocks, from text, media and card layouts to testimonials, countdown, lobby, app download and FAQ. The Website builder offers a library of static content blocks for building event site pages.

Built five website builder Exhibitors block variants, as slider or static, filtered by exhibitor category, product category, tag or specific exhibitors. Organisers add exhibitor blocks with chosen cards per row, sort order and style, card and button settings.

Built five Products blocks for the Website Builder with slider or static display, card counts, sorting, category or exhibitor selection and style settings. Organisers can place configurable product showcases on event websites, choosing which products and card details appear and how they look.

Built three News blocks for the Website Builder with slider or static display, card counts and filtering by tag, category, source, date or specific news. Organisers show curated news on event websites, choosing which articles appear and whether dates and authors show on cards.

Built five Brands blocks for the Website Builder with slider or static display, card counts, sorting, selection by category, tag or exhibitor, and style settings. Organisers can add configurable brand showcases to event websites, choosing which brands appear and how the cards look.

Built the Website builder Sponsors block in several layouts, with slider or static display, card counts, sorting, sponsor category filters and style settings. Event sites can show sponsors in configurable carousel or static blocks filtered by category or chosen sponsors.

Built a website builder Speakers block in two variants, as slider or static, with style, card, sorting and speaker-tag settings. Organisers add speaker blocks to pages, choosing layout, cards per row, sort order and which tagged or specific speakers appear.

Built website builder Session block variants with carousel, card and button settings, filtered by category, track, type, tag, featured or start date. Organisers show selected sessions on site pages as sliders or static blocks with their chosen styling.

Added a Custom Content block to the new Website Builder with background, overlay, text and padding settings, plus a rich-text editor with tables, columns, images and YouTube. Organisers build free-form content sections with full text formatting, undo/redo, images, tables, columns and embedded videos.

summary: [next14] Change swiper logic to carousel when not enough slides
~Buttons Block~ - New website builder (ability to use simple components block)

summary: [site builder] Add to the custom CSS support for pseudo-class
text: Added pseudo-class support such as :hover to the site builder's custom CSS. Custom CSS can style hover states.

summary: Transferring new website builder when cloning an event
[sitebulder] Add support special links to the links
text: Added mailto, tel and anchor link support to the site builder. Site builder links can open email, phone or page sections.

summary: Part 2 - Improve Text Editor in the New Website Builder

Built customisable header and footer components for the website builder: logo, navigation, search, CTAs, announcement bar, contact, legal links and sitemap. Organisers configure header and footer content and styles from one menu, with several footer styles.

summary: Font Size Customization for Header Menu Items

Added header scroll settings to the website builder: scroll, sticky and disappear-on-scroll. Organisers choose how the header behaves on scroll.

summary: Website builder. Visibility Settings for Links and Buttons and Pages access
